source.title: The Talisman of Kazdor
source.description:
From the most recent letter we intercepted, it appears the final artifact Caius desires is the Talisman of Kazdor. The letter states this talisman is somewhere inside Zul'Farrak.

I want you to complete the job as per Caius' instructions, as not to arouse his suspicion. This means you'll have to go into Zul'Farrak alone, as usual.

However, before you deliver the Talisman, bring it back here. We'll be giving Caius a little more than he asked for.
source.objective: Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone.
source.progress: Go now, time is of the essence.
source.completion: Some fine thievery indeed, <name>. Now, time for step two.
